# langsmith_insights_config (Resource)

**Beta.** Manages a LangSmith run-insights (clustering) job config attached to a tracing project. The `config` is a complex object with many optional fields (model, hierarchy, partitions, filter, summary_prompt, etc.) so it is exposed as a JSON-encoded string — see the LangSmith API reference for `CreateRunClusteringJobRequest`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_insights_config" "topics" {
  session_id    = langsmith_project.production.id
  name          = "Daily topic clusters"
  description   = "Group last-24h runs by user intent"
  schedule_cron = "0 3 * * *"

  # See LangSmith docs: CreateRunClusteringJobRequest.
  config = jsonencode({
    last_n_hours = 24
    model        = "openai"
    hierarchy    = [10, 50]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) JSON-encoded clustering job configuration (`CreateRunClusteringJobRequest` body).
- `name` (String) Job config name (max 255 chars).
- `session_id` (String) UUID of the tracing project (session) the config attaches to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `schedule_cron` (String) Cron expression to schedule the job.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
